newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Low offer in Nepal kerosene tender about $272-$275.
newsitem.headline: Low offer in Nepal kerosene tender about $272-$275.

text.p: Low offers into state-owned Nepal Oil Co's (NOC) tender to buy 30,000 tonnes of superior kerosene for February arrival was around $272-$275 a tonne, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Indian east coast basis, an industry source said on Tuesday.
The cargo is for February 1-20 delivery to Madras/Vizag or Madras/Haldia.
Meanwhile, the lowest offer in Nepal's tender to buy 30,000 tonnes of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel was slightly more than $239 per tonne and was made by European major Shell.
The diesel cargo is for February 11-20 delivery, c-and-f Madras/Vizag, Madras/Haldia, Paradeep or Paradeep/Haldia.
The source said the tender would be awarded by Tuesday evening and the results would be known by early Wednesday.
NOC delayed the closing date of the tender to January 12 with validity until January 14, from the original close on January 7 as no offers had been submitted by the first deadline.
NOC last bought diesel and kerosene for delivery in November at $232.80 per tonne and $249.50 per tonne respectively, on a c-and-f Indian east coast basis.
